node.title: Deployed identity-prefix floors do not enter B_ap
node.statement: At the four deployed upstream rows, the exact identity-prefix lower attacks straddle their printed adjacent budgets, but their objects are boundary/higher-shell Q on list rows and simple-pole list-to-MCA owners on MCA rows. They are stripped before the local post-strip aperiodic residual, so they do not falsify local B_ap columns. The below-budget attack at the next row is not a safety certificate.
node.notes: Resolves roadmap N3 with verdict NO ISSUE. Upstream source main@32a41660; source hashes and exact row contracts are pinned. This proves ownership separation, not any B_ap upper bound or safe row.
